description: Fetch Instagram's Explore grid (instagram.com/explore/) — algorithmically recommended media from across the platform, personalized to the logged-in account. Returns media tiles with shortcode, URL, type (image/video/carousel), and thumbnail; scrolls internally via the explore_grid API up to 100 items, partial=true when the grid stops producing. Use instagram/get-post on any tile URL for caption and comments. Requires a logged-in Instagram session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tiles to return (1-100, default 20). Fetches additional pages via the explore_grid cursor until the limit is reached; partial=true when the grid stops loading before the limit.
